scenes.setting: Direct continuation: Danitz frowns as he watches Gehrman Sparrow walk out of the suite, unsure what he really wants with the Captain
scenes.text_anchor: Danitz frowned as he watched Gehrman Sparrow leave the room

scenes.setting: Alone in the suite, Danitz reasons his way to 'a powerful and secretive organization behind Gehrman Sparrow', fears for his Captain's 26,000-pound bounty, finds the Flying Carpet and Shadow Cloak untouched, and resolves to stay put rather than lead anyone to her
scenes.text_anchor: I will not bring danger to Captain!

scenes.setting: Quarter past three, Symeem Island: Klein steps off the five-hour liner in cheap local pantaloons and a brown cap, wearing an unremarkable native face (no named guise), tallies his fortune at 7,110 pounds, and walks into the bronze-skinned port town thinking about the Nightmare characteristic and Little Sun
scenes.text_anchor: A quarter past three in the afternoon, Symeem Island.

scenes.setting: (Klein wearing the dead sailor Wendt's face) The winery at the town's edge: wearing the dead sailor Wendt's tall thin face, Klein 'acts' the confession Wendt never made -- Raine calls him a coward and chases him off with a broom; he puts her to sleep with a charm so it will feel like a dream, watches her wake and curse 'Wendt, you selfish bastard!', feels the potion digest a little, and changes his face again
scenes.text_anchor: “Raine, I like you. I wish to marry you.
